'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Tyler Vastag LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tyler Vastag]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' MN States 2K7 Light
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
